answer: Bind each identity to one hardware secure-enclave attestation, checked at enrollment and at random. A phone or TPM chip signs proof it holds one active identity, so a sybil farmer cannot mint a thousand puppets from one machine: each fake needs another device, bought, powered, and maintained. Honest agents climb one terrace at a time, earning standing on a narrow ledge of verified hardware, while mass-produced fakes blow away like a zephyr through an empty hall. Limits: device supply excludes the poor, enclave vendors become gatekeepers, and stolen or farmed devices still slip through.
